one_liner: Explored a hydration-aware vending concept through research, data modeling, and an interactive prototype.
projectSummary: Researched hydration detection, modeled simulated sensor data, and built an AI-assisted prototype for a hydration-aware vending experience.

problem.summary: The team needed a grounded way to evaluate whether an AI-assisted hydration experience was feasible without access to real sensors or hardware.

goals: Understand feasible approaches to hydration detection for consumer environments
Model simulated hydration data based on scientific research
Design interpretation logic for AI-assisted product recommendations
Prototype the end-to-end user flow for early concept evaluation
Explore both near-term feasibility and far-future product directions
responsibilities: Researched hydration science and existing detection hardware
Created a simulated hydration data model with realistic variability
Designed interpretation rules mapping hydration states to product sets
Built an interactive prototype demonstrating the full experience
Collaborated with creative leadership to refine behavior and flow
Outlined far-future vision concepts such as nutrient-mixing systems
outcomes: Delivered a working prototype that demonstrated the hydration-aware experience
Helped the team evaluate feasibility and user understanding before hardware investment
Provided clarity on which aspects of hydration detection were plausible
Established a near-term concept and a far-future vision for leadership review
